impact: Unlinking manifest.json is not atomic for a reader that ALREADY read the old manifest and is now walking artifacts a reset is deleting — it can observe missing/mixed artifacts, or misreport a reset as corruption/quarantine. Fix: reads become an optimistic snapshot transaction — validate manifest identity, load+validate all referenced artifacts, then re-read and compare manifest identity/checksum; changed/absent ⇒ no-snapshot or retry; an artifact vanishing mid-read re-checks the manifest BEFORE classifying corruption. Interleave reset and publication at every artifact read: every outcome must be complete-old, complete-new, or no-snapshot.
title: [architecture] Unlinking manifest.json is not atomic for a reader that ALREADY read the old man
